name: Bram Tolley
description: Flour in his eyebrows. Brings the smell of the bakery in with him.

visits.greeting: Morning! Busy? Not busy. Good. I'm never not busy, me.

request.text: Something for warmth. My ovens go cold by the small hours come winter, and bread won't rise in a cold oven.

readThoughts.default: Four in the morning. Flour to the elbow. Cold brick.

purpose.1: The ovens. Brick holds heat, they say. Not my brick.

source.0: Ada Marsh swears by your kitchen books. Don't tell her I said.

lent.line: Champion. There's a loaf in it for you.

offerRefused.line: Won't warm an oven, that. Something kitchen-ish?

declined.line: Ah well. Extra coal it is.

good.text: A loaf on the house, any morning you like. The ovens hold till dawn now. — Bram, Tolley's Bakery
